leadership.name: PRAN NATH SONI
leadership.title: Founding Visionary
leadership.bio: Instilled the founding vision, strategic enterprise ethos, and cross-cultural commitment to elevating Vietnam's regional culinary heritage to a premier international standard.

leadership.name: VO THI VIEN
leadership.title: Director & Culinary Custodian (Cô Viên)
leadership.bio: The culinary artisan and heartbeat of the brand. Safeguards generation-old Quang Nam family recipes, ingredient purism, handcrafted noodle texture, and traditional slow-braised umami reductions.

leadership.name: CHAYAN SONI
leadership.title: Chief Executive Officer
leadership.bio: Leads brand strategy, corporate governance, operational scaling across Thu Duc City hubs, and modern technological integration to establish Mì Quảng Cô Viên as an industry benchmark.

pillars.title: Artisanal Fresh Rice Noodles
pillars.detail: Kneaded and cut fresh daily from indigenous non-sticky paddy rice, naturally tinted with warm golden turmeric.

pillars.title: The Concentrated 'Nhưn' Broth
pillars.detail: Simmered into a rich, savory essence rather than a full bowl of soup, coating every noodle strand in pure flavor.

pillars.title: The Nine-Herb Basket
pillars.detail: Shaved young banana blossom, fish mint, Thai basil, and Vietnamese coriander sourced fresh every dawn.

pillars.title: Toasted Sesame Rice Crackers
pillars.detail: Thick, aromatic sesame rice paper toasted over hot coals to provide the essential crisp texture.

pillars.title: Cold-Pressed Peanut Oil & Shallots
pillars.detail: Pure unrefined peanut oil infused with crushed native shallots (củ nén) for the unmistakable Central scent.
